Name: MsCrowley's Seasonal Scarecrows
Author: MsCrowley
Description:
[center]A simple mod which adds seasonal variations to the vanilla scarecrows.

[b]Please let me know:
- If there are any bugs;[/b]
This is my first mod - it's rather simple, so I doubt there will be any issues, but just in case.
[b]- If you have any suggestions;[/b]
I am not an expert spriter by any means, and I honestly didn't have a very good idea for most of these. I just use a lot of seasonal mods and felt the scarecrows a bit lacking. I couldn't find a seasonal scarecrow mod, so I decided to make my own.
[b]- If you create an alternative version of this mod;[/b]
You are more than welcome to edit the sprites in this mod and reupload your own version of it. Please let me know if you do so I can check it out!

I don't think I'm forgetting anything, but again, this is my first mod, so if I've forgotten any important info here, please tell me![/center]
